run_count_docs: run the script to count documents and average lines and tokens per document in a large file
run_count_docs_gzip: run the script with --gzip flag to count documents in a gzip compressed file
review_main: review the main function that parses args and iterates over lines to count docs, lines, and tokens
summarize_gopen: summarize the gopen helper function that opens a file normally or via gzip based on the --gzip flag
refactor_count_docs: refactor the count_docs script to support custom document separator patterns instead of empty lines
